parameters.content:
## 🛡️ Safe by default
Imports in **SANDBOX_MODE=true · DRY_RUN=true · SCORE_UPDATE_ENABLED=false · SEND_SLACK_ALERTS=false**.

Out of the box: zero HubSpot calls, zero CRM writes, zero Slack posts. Synthetic fixture only.

**Live writes need ALL of:** SANDBOX_MODE=false, DRY_RUN=false, SCORE_UPDATE_ENABLED=true, HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN set, and no circuit breaker tripped.

Secrets are read only via `$env` inside HTTP nodes and never copied into execution data.

Requires `N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false`. If env access is blocked, the run falls back to sandbox + dry-run.

## 📐 Scoring matrix (defaults)
Headcount growth 30% · Funding 30% · Technographic 25% · Firmographic 15%

Tier 1 ≥ 80 · Tier 2 ≥ 60 · Tier 3 ≥ 40 · else Unqualified

Downgrade hysteresis 3 pts · Drift alert ≥ 5 pts · Min 2 signal components

All weights, thresholds and matrices are env-configurable. See README.md.
